paper_statement: Across the 16 one-model-per-family ensembles evaluated on each of UltraFeedback, MMLU, and ARMMAN, OW-L beats MV in 97.92% of dataset-ensemble cases. MV is never the best proposed method, and the per-case lift of the best of OW-L, OW-I, and ISP over MV ranges from 0.54 to 14.20 percentage points.
acceptance: all 48 table rows and the full 2x2x2x2 ensemble design are present
OW-L is strictly more accurate than MV in exactly 47/48 cases, which rounds to 97.92%
for each case take max(OW-L, OW-I, ISP)-MV; the exact published two-decimal range is 0.54..14.20 percentage points
count, range, and quantifier-conflation negative controls are rejected
verifier exits nonzero on any failure
interpretation_guard: The 0.54..14.20 range does not describe OW-L alone. OW-L's own signed range in the published tables is -0.51..14.20 percentage points.
